_source_note: Fully rebuilt (3rd pass, Sept 2026) from 43 real in-game tooltip screenshots pulled directly from Ascension by Kyle (Veenomancer.docx). Major corrections from earlier passes: Serpent's Fang is Lvl 2 not Lvl 1 (35 dmg/45 heal at rank 1, not the higher-rank 72/62 numbers seen before); Shadra's Prayer is VIZIER-LOCKED, not class-wide - moved out of this file into the Vizier spec tree; Spider Form is Lvl 4, not Lvl 6 (screenshot straight from the live game takes priority over Skills_3.docx's outline); Venom Fang added as its own real Lvl 4 ability (flat 24 Nature dmg), separate from Venom Bolt. Per Kyle: starting abilities rank up much further than a 4-5 rank cap (up to Rank 8-10) - Venom Bolt/Serpent's Fang/Venom Fang given longer rank tails accordingly, unlike the shorter curves used for other classes' spammables so far.

abilities.name: Attack
abilities.description: A basic claw strike.

abilities.name: Venom Bolt
abilities.description: Spew poison on an enemy.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: 11 Mana, 30yd, 2s cast, '19 Nature damage' at Rank 1. Core level-1 spammer - per Kyle, starting abilities get a long rank tail (up to Rank 8-10), not the 5-rank cap used elsewhere.

abilities.name: Serpent's Fang
abilities.description: Launch vile poison at an enemy, dealing Nature damage and healing up to 5 allies near them.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 2 (was Lvl 1), instant, '35 Nature damage and healing up to 5 allies near them for 45' at Rank 1. Uses damage_and_heal with heal_scope=5, same mechanism as before, corrected level and rank-1 numbers.

abilities.name: Venom Fang
abilities.description: Bite an enemy with venomous fangs.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 4, '24 Nature damage' at Rank 1. Flat single-target melee-ish bite, distinct from Venom Bolt (Mana caster spell) and Claw Strike (Beetle-locked cleave) - this is the base-kit bite attack.

abilities.name: Vile Sting
abilities.description: Taunt an enemy to attack you. If the target isn't currently targeting you, triggers your active Venoms.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 12, 'Taunts an enemy target to attack you for 3 sec. If the target is tauntable and not currently targeting you, you trigger your current Venoms.'

abilities.name: Spider Pheromones
abilities.description: Inject an ally with spider pheromones, increasing their Agility.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 10, '+6 Agility. Lasts 30 min.'

abilities.name: Emerald Veil
abilities.description: Envelop an ally in an emerald veil, healing them and shielding them from damage.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 14, 'healing them for 416 and shielding them, absorbing up to 36 damage. Lasts 20 sec.' Shield component not yet modeled (heal-only for now) - see _implementation_note.
abilities._implementation_note: Real tooltip also grants a 20-sec damage-absorb shield alongside the heal - this engine doesn't have a generic 'shield' status effect yet (only heal/hot/buff/debuff/dot). Flagging rather than half-implementing; revisit once a shield mechanic exists.

abilities.name: Antivenom
abilities.description: Cure a poison effect on the target, repeating over several seconds.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 16, 'Cure 1 poison effect on the target, repeating every 4 seconds for 12 sec.'

abilities.name: Green Salve
abilities.description: Rapidly heal an ally over time, then seek out another low-health ally to heal.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 16, tagged 'Venomancer (1)' - a generic talent-point gate (any 1 point spent, not spec-specific), 'heal an ally for 60 over 6 sec. At the end of the duration, seek another nearby ally with the lowest health and heal them for 72.' The chain-to-another-target clause isn't modeled (single-target hot only) - flag for a follow-up.

abilities.name: Beetle Pheromones
abilities.description: Increase the friendly target's Armor and all primary stats. Does not stack with similar effects.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 20, '+105 Armor and all primary stats by 4. Lasts 30 min.'

abilities.name: Nullifying Toxin
abilities.description: Inject an enemy with nullifying toxin, interrupting their cast and preventing that school from being cast.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 22, 'interrupting them and preventing any spell from that school from being cast for 3 sec.'

abilities.name: Chitin Rush
abilities.description: Rush forward and strike enemies in your path. Generates increased threat.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 28, '38 Nature damage. Damage dealt generates increased threat.'

abilities.name: Toxic Pheromones
abilities.description: Create a magic edict with an ally, increasing their Spell Power.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 28, '+28 Spell Power.'

abilities.name: Venom Shield
abilities.description: Reduce the duration of poison effects used on you and reduce periodic Magic damage taken.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 40, exact numbers verbatim.

abilities.name: Shadra's Boon
abilities.description: Increase the Nature Resistance of all party and raid members. Does not stack with similar effects.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 50, '+1 Nature Resistance.'

abilities.name: Debilitating Venom
abilities.description: Activate Debilitating Venom for 2 hrs: your casts have a chance to inject a target and nearby enemies with a crippling venom that slows movement speed. Maximum 2 unique Venoms active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 8, 'giving your casts a 30% chance to inject a target and enemies around them with a crippling venom that slows their movement speed by 40% for 8 sec.' Part of the Venom family (Debilitating/Rejuvenating/Nullifying/Blight) - max 2 active. 2hr real-world duration modeled as a 30-min WoW-buff-style duration per project convention (matches Rounds/other long buffs).

abilities.name: Rejuvenating Venom
abilities.description: Activate Rejuvenating Venom for 2 hrs: your casts have a chance to heal a random nearby ally. Maximum 2 unique Venoms active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 14 (was Lvl 1), 'giving your casts a 20% chance to heal a random ally within 30 yds of your target for 2 over 6 sec.' Part of the Venom family.

abilities.name: Nullifying Venom
abilities.description: Activate Nullifying Venom for 2 hrs: your casts have a chance to reduce an enemy's casting speed. Maximum 2 unique Venoms active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 18, 'giving your casts a 30% chance to reduce an enemy's casting speed by 30% for 8 sec.' Part of the Venom family.

abilities.name: Blight Venom
abilities.description: Activate Blight Venom for 2 hrs: your harmful spells and abilities have a chance to poison an enemy. Maximum 2 unique Venoms active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: level not shown in this tooltip crop, estimated. 'giving your harmful spells and abilities a 30% chance to poison an enemy dealing 26 Shadow Damage over 6 sec.' Part of the Venom family.
abilities._implementation_note: 'Maximum 2 unique Venoms active at a time' means this family should really allow 2 simultaneous picks, not 1 like Tinker's Rounds. exclusive_group as built only supports 'exactly 1 at a time' - this is modeled as 1-at-a-time for now (undertuned vs the real 2-at-a-time), flag for a proper multi-slot exclusive-group mechanic if this matters for gameplay feel.

abilities.name: Shadra's Prayer
abilities.description: Bring the glory of Shadra to an ally, healing them immediately and over time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 2, Vizier-locked, 65 Mana, 40yd, 2s cast, '48 healing, plus 9 every 3 sec for 24 sec' (higher-rank numbers - rank 1 is '32 healing, plus 5 every 3 sec').

abilities.name: Alkahest
abilities.description: Bless an ally with Shadra's grace, healing them and extending Shadra's Prayer.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 20, 2 Charges, 12 sec recharge, '152 healing, extending Shadra's Prayer duration by 9 sec.' Duration-extension clause not yet modeled.

abilities.name: Mending Mist
abilities.description: Spread a mist across the party, healing them over time then again shortly after.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 22, 'heal for 15 every 1 sec for 10 sec. After 1.6 sec, an additional 149.' Party-wide (up to 8 allies) - target_type party not currently supported cleanly for hot, modeled single-target for now.

abilities.name: Shadra's Balm
abilities.description: Envelop an ally with a restorative balm, healing them over time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 24, 'healing them for 41 every 3 sec for 21 sec.'

abilities.name: Blight Antidote
abilities.description: Cull 2 curse effects from an ally.
abilities._source: Referenced in earlier extraction ('pulling 2 curse effects from them') - Vizier-locked dispel.

abilities.name: Carapace Crash
abilities.description: Slam your body against the ground, damaging nearby enemies. Requires Beetle Form.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 10/16 (Rank 1/2), 'dealing 33/45 Nature damage to enemies within 8 yds.'

abilities.name: Hivebreak
abilities.description: Pierce an enemy with your front leg. Requires Beetle Form.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 10, '33 Nature damage.'

abilities.name: Expulsion
abilities.description: Clear your Exposed Flesh stacks to poison nearby enemies.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 18, 'poison nearby enemies for 5 sec plus 1 sec per cleared stack, dealing 18 Nature damage every 1 sec.'

abilities.name: Venomtip Poison
abilities.description: Spray poison on an enemy and nearby enemies, reducing their attack speed.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 34, '38 Nature damage and reducing attack speed by 20% for 15 sec.'

abilities.name: Harden
abilities.description: Harden your carapace, reducing damage taken. Decays over time. Requires Beetle Form.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 30, 3 min cooldown, 'reducing damage taken by 45%, decaying quickly over 10 sec and healing for 1% max health each time a stack is removed. Leaving Beetle Form cancels this effect.' Fortitude's real capstone defensive cooldown.

abilities.name: Locust Swarm
abilities.description: A swarm of locusts taunts all nearby enemies. Requires Beetle Form.
abilities._source: Kept from earlier pass - real numbers not yet confirmed via this screenshot batch.

abilities.name: Nerubian Sting
abilities.description: Sting an enemy with a stacking Shadow poison, applying a Brood Mark.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 20, 'dealing 32 Shadow damage and an additional 35 over 15 sec, stacking up to 3 times. Applies 1 Brood Mark.'

abilities.name: Withering Venom
abilities.description: Inject an enemy with a devastating, escalating venom, applying a Brood Mark.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: 'dealing 24 Nature damage every 3 sec for 21 sec, damage increasing over time. Applies 1 Brood Mark.'

abilities.name: Widowmaker
abilities.description: Inject shadow venom into an enemy, consuming Brood Marks for damage and reducing their healing received. Requires Spider Form.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: 20 Energy, melee range, instant, Requires Spider Form, Consumes Brood Marks. Full per-Mark table: 1 Mark 95, 2:122, 3:156, 4:198, 5:266 Shadow damage, plus 'reducing healing received by 50% for 8 sec.' Scaling with Marks not yet dynamically modeled - uses a flat mid-tier value.

abilities.name: Facemelter
abilities.description: Spray poison upon an enemy and nearby enemies, consuming Brood Marks. Requires Spider Form.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: 30 Energy, 20yd, instant, Requires Spider Form, Consumes Brood Marks. Full per-Mark table: 1 Mark 144, 2:184, 3:236, 4:299, 5:403 Nature damage over 15 sec.

abilities.name: Rotfang
abilities.description: Inject venom that rots an enemy from the inside out, piercing resistances. Real Plague damage (Nature+Shadow combined school - resolves against whichever of the target's Nature/Shadow resistances is LOWER, matching real WoW's Plague damage type and Kyle's combined-school design: combined types are harder to resist, not easier). Requires Spider Form. Consumes Brood Marks (per-Mark scaling not yet dynamically modeled - uses a flat mid-tier value, per the original source note).
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: 25 Energy, melee range, instant, Requires Spider Form, Consumes Brood Marks. Full per-Mark table: 1 Mark 320, 2:410, 3:525, 4:666, 5:896 Plague damage over 24 sec, 'pierces resistances.' Stalking's real capstone finisher.

abilities.name: Spore
abilities.description: Inject an enemy with parasitic spores, dealing Shadow damage over time, then dropping a delayed-detonation mushroom.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 20, 11 Mana, 30yd, 1.5s cast, '50 Shadow damage, plus 308-329 over 21 sec. After 10 sec, drops a Mushroom that explodes after 2 sec for 10 Nature damage to nearby enemies.' Mushroom-drop clause not yet modeled.

abilities.name: Wilt
abilities.description: Wilt the life from an enemy with vile poison.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 20, '234 Nature damage over 18 sec.'

abilities.name: Mycosis
abilities.description: Fungus grows throughout an enemy's body, dealing Nature damage and shielding them from healing.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 24, 11 Mana, 30yd, 2.5s cast, 15s CD, '202 Nature damage and applying a shield that absorbs the next 160 healing for 8 sec. Deals 20% increased damage per stack of Fungal Growth.' Healing-absorb shield not yet modeled as a real mechanic.

abilities.name: Spindlebind
abilities.description: Emit webs at all enemies, rooting them and dealing Nature damage.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 24, 'rooting them for 4 sec and inflicting 83 Nature damage.'

abilities.name: Decay
abilities.description: A creeping Nature damage-over-time spell that spreads to nearby enemies when it expires.
abilities._source: Referenced in earlier tooltip extraction (Cycle of Decay talent). Real numbers not yet confirmed via a dedicated screenshot for this specific batch.

abilities.name: Spider Form
abilities.description: Shapeshift into Spider Form, allowing the use of claw-based abilities and increasing movement speed.
abilities._source: Real castable shapeshift, per Kyle's direction that forms should be actual spells rather than a separate menu. Uses the existing combat/forms.py 'spider' form data (Lvl 6, Energy resource) - this ability is the cast button, the mechanical details still live in forms.py.

abilities.name: Beetle Form
abilities.description: Shapeshift into Beetle Form, allowing the use of claw-based abilities and increasing Armor and Stamina.
abilities._source: Real castable shapeshift. Uses the existing combat/forms.py 'beetle' form data (Lvl 10, Rage resource).

abilities.name: Weaver Form
abilities.description: Shapeshift into Weaver Form, reducing spell pushback and granting periodic mana return.
abilities._source: Real castable shapeshift. Uses the existing combat/forms.py 'weaver' form data (Lvl 30, Mana resource, no resource-type change since Weaver stays Mana).

abilities.name: Vizier Form
abilities.description: Shapeshift into Vizier Form, increasing healing done and reducing healing costs. Also enables Serpent's Fang to heal instead of damage.
abilities._source: Real castable shapeshift. Uses the existing combat/forms.py 'vizier_form' form data (Lvl 40, Mana resource). Named venomancer_vizier_form_ability (not venomancer_vizier_form) to avoid colliding with the forms.py dict key 'vizier_form' itself.
